title: Anthropic opens its most powerful AI models to more security teams
key_facts: Cyber Verification Program now has three tiers: Defense Access, Red Team Access and Specialized Access
Each tier includes the company's most capable models, including Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Mythos 5.1
Defense Access covers defensive work such as incident response and malware analysis; applications answered in a few days
Red Team Access adds authorised penetration testing; reviews take a few weeks; real-time blocks remain on actions such as deploying ransomware
Specialized Access, with the fewest blocks, is for verified organisations testing systems such as power grids, telecom and interbank transfer networks; each is reviewed with the US government
Data retention is required for enrolled organisations to monitor for cyber misuse
Project Glasswing members move to the Specialized tier without reapproval
quote_evidence: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
Cybersecurity is inherently dual use: the same capabilities that enable a security team to find and fix a vulnerability can also help a malicious actor exploit it.
Data retention is required for organizations enrolled in the program so that we can monitor for cyber misuse.
why_it_matters_hint: More defenders get strong AI tools for security work, with vetting meant to limit misuse.
notes: Reuters page blocked (HTTP 401); written from Anthropic's own announcement page, which Reuters carried. Anthropic is a maker of the models described, so the account is the company's own.
